title: Rakuten Viki, Imaginus to Debut AI-Assisted Korean-Animated Series The Painted Soul on October 21
content: Rakuten Viki announced on October 9 that it will premiere The Painted Soul , a 10-episode animated series co-produced with South Korean production company Imaginus, exclusively on its platform on October 21 in select international markets.
author: ANN

title: 'Hametsu no Oukoku' Creator Launches New Manga
content: The 46th issue of Weekly Shounen Champion magazine announced on October 15 that manga creator yoruhashi will launch a new manga, titled Tatarigatachi: Dochakushin Geigeki Gakuin ( Curse Shape: Native God Interception Academy ), in the magazine next issue, scheduled for an October 22 release.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Hoshi in the Girls' Garden Tops Oricon's Comic Ranking for September
content: The fifth volume of Yama Wayama 's Hoshi in the Girls' Garden ( Onna no Sono no Hoshi ) manga topped the chart, selling 182,399 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on September 8. The manga was nominated in the 18th Manga Taisho Awards, and 49th Kodansha Manga Awards last year.
author: ANN

title: Satomi, Nanamori Graduate From Strawberry Prince Group
content: The official website for the Strawberry Prince (SutoPuri) group announced on Sunday that Satomi and Nanamori. have graduated from the group. Nanamori. will continue to be the producer and manager of the group (he will no longer perform in concerts or songs), but Satomi will go on to do solo activities.
author: ANN

title: The Kingdoms of Ruin's yoruhashi Launches New Manga on Thursday
content: This year's 46th issue of Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine revealed on October 15 that manga creator yoruhashi will launch a new manga titled Tatarigatachi -Dochakushin Geigeki Gakuin- (Curse Shape -Native God Interception Academy-, seen at top of image below) in the magazine's next issue on Thursday.

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Reveals Global Release Times, All Episodes to Drop at Once on October 20
content: CYBERPUNK: EDGERUNNERS 2 has revealed its global release schedule ahead of its October 20, 2026 premiere on Netflix. The official release timing map confirms that the new anime will arrive simultaneously worldwide, beginning at 12:00 a.m. PDT in Los Angeles.

title: Kanon, Air, Clannad, Heaven Burns Red's Jun Maeda in Palliative Care for Pharyngeal Cancer
content: Visual Arts/Key announced on Monday that writer and composer Jun Maeda ( Kanon , Air , Clannad , Angel Beats! ) has been diagnosed with pharyngeal cancer, and has chosen to focus on palliative care, after considering his condition and the outlook for possible treatment.
